fact: A feather-light sub-Earth hugging the nearest star — one of the lowest-mass planets ever found.
bio: Proxima Centauri d is a tiny world, only about a quarter of Earth's mass, whirling around Proxima Centauri every five days far too close to be habitable. Confirmed in the 2020s, it sits near the very limit of what our instruments can detect, a testament to how precisely we can now weigh unseen planets by the wobble they induce in their star.
